 Follow General Hospital’s Kelly Monaco Mourns On a Heartbreaking Anniversary: ‘Missing a Piece of My Heart’
 Curtis Harding Fri, November 13, 2026 at 8:32 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kelly Monaco has seen her share of loss. Just this past September, General Hospital 's former Sam shared a letter from her late, beloved co-star, Billy Miller (Drew), on his "heavenly birthday." Just two months later, Monaco marks another occasion, as it's been five years since she lost her dear friend, Heath Freeman at the tragically young age of 41.
 "Missing a piece of my heart," Monaco shared on an Instagram post with "A Love Story" slideshow of photos of the two of them. "It's been five years, but this year hits different. Heath Freeman you are missed and loved by so many."

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As to why this year might feel a bit different, Monaco added the hashtag "#sober." The actress has shared her journey in giving up alcohol on Instagram, proudly (and more than a little cheekily) posting back in September that she'd been alcohol free for six months and seven days. Or, as she put it, "Now the whole six/seven thing makes sense!" (For those who don't get the joke, ask a Gen Alpha kid.)
 Text reads, Subscribe to Soaps' General Hospital Newsletter. Get breaking news alerts, daily recaps, exclusive interviews and spoilers sent straight to your inbox https://cloud.email.soaps.com/signup/ Freeman, we sadly learned , died of a drug overdose, which involved a combination of alcohol and narcotics in his system. So we can understand why this year, as Monaco celebrates her own sobriety, remembering his loss might feel a bit different.
 We're proud of Monaco for making the change, our hearts go out to her as she remembers Freeman on what has to be a difficult day.
 While you're here paying respects, take a moment to reflect on all those we've lost in the daytime world so far this year.
